neighbours.label: the word for 'month' as a calendar unit across languages (this month, Awareness Month, mois de / mes de before a month name, شهر); the same sentences with week or year stay low
fire: We are trying to save a little more money each month this year.
The library is celebrating Black History Month with a series of talks.
Les travaux commenceront au début du mois de septembre selon la mairie.
El festival se celebra cada año durante el mes de agosto en la costa.
يصوم المسلمون في شهر رمضان من الفجر حتى غروب الشمس.
My phone bill went up by ten dollars last month without any warning.
Our school marks Heart Health Month with a fun run for families.
The rent is due on the first day of every month, my landlord reminded me.
quiet: We are trying to save a little more money each week this year.
The library is celebrating its anniversary with a series of talks.
Les travaux commenceront au début de la semaine prochaine selon la mairie.
El festival se celebra cada año durante el verano en la costa.
يصوم المسلمون في النهار من الفجر حتى غروب الشمس.
My phone bill went up by ten dollars last year without any warning.
Our school marks its founding with a fun run for families.
The rent is due on the first day of every week, my landlord reminded me.

notes: Card: ' de' after mois/mes, ' Month', ' month', ' شهر'. Probe: National Poetry Month 0.864, this month 0.723, mois de 0.723, شهر 0.631, mes de 0.570; this week 0.063, mois removed 0.007. 'April is a rainy season' 0.415 (month name lead-in predicts Month), so near misses avoid month names before the slot.
